---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarize(
    career_HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_year = min(yearID, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_year = max(yearID, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(career_HR)) |>
  head(15) |>
  left_join(People, by = "playerID") |>
  mutate(
    name = paste(nameFirst, nameLast),
    span = paste(first_year, last_year, sep = "-"),
    steroid_era = last_year >= 1994 & first_year <= 2009
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = career_HR, y = reorder(name, career_HR), fill = steroid_era)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 All-Time Home Run Leaders",
    x = "Career Home Runs",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Active 1994-2009",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  )
```


```{r}
Batting |>
  left_join(People, by = "playerID") |>
  filter(nameFirst == "Barry", nameLast == "Bonds") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = HR)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds Home Runs by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home Runs",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  )
```
